description: Routes an unavailable WinRT enum value to exact metadata lookup without upgrading dependencies.
prompt: 'BlockedByUser' isn't a member of StartupTaskState in Vireo Beacon. Which enum value means the user disabled startup? We're pinned to Windows SDK 10.0.19041.0.

paraphrases.novice: Vireo Beacon won't compile the name I copied from a blog. What does our Windows SDK call the result where someone has turned automatic startup off?
paraphrases.terse: Vireo C2039: StartupTaskState::BlockedByUser. Correct member for SDK 10.0.19041.0?
